title: TBD Map Object Instance (catalog v1 placement row)
description: One placed object. Compact: it references its prefab by index and never duplicates kind, class, resourceName or bounds — resolve those through `prefabs[prefabId]`. Three equivalent JSON encodings exist: an expanded object (the readable form, used by goldens), a legacy id-first positional array `[id, prefabId, x, y, z?, rotationDeg?]`, and the chunk wire tuple `[prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg]` or, at objects schemaVersion 1.1.0 and above, `[prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, scale]` (all numbers; the id is derived as {cx}_{cy}:{index}). The discriminator between the two array forms is element 0: a string means the legacy tuple, a number the chunk tuple. A fourth encoding of the same row is not JSON at all — the 32-byte ObjectInstancePod inside a TBDC container, documented byte for byte at `$defs/objectInstancePodRow` below.

objectInstancePodRow.title: ObjectInstancePod — the 32-byte binary row
objectInstancePodRow.description: NOT a JSON Schema validator (JSON Schema cannot describe bytes) — this is the wire contract for objects/chunks/{cx}_{cy}.bin, recorded beside the JSON rows it encodes so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. One .bin is a 32-byte TbdcHeader followed by `count` of these and nothing else, so byte offset of row i is 32 + 32 * i and the whole ingest is a length check plus one bytemuck::cast_slice. All fields little-endian; the struct is #[repr(C)] with no padding, which is what the field ORDER below buys. A 5-wide JSON row decodes with pitchDeg = rollDeg = 0 and scale = 1. Live definition: crates/map-engine-core/src/world/binary/pod.rs; the manifest names it as objects.binary.pod / podBytes so a loader can refuse a shape it does not implement. Checked by `cargo xtask schema terrain-manifest` (arithmetic: no gap, no overlap, total = POD_BYTES) and by golden_gate S15, which decodes the committed golden .bin at these very offsets.

fields.name: yaw
fields.unit: degrees; the JSON row's rotationDeg, Enfusion GetAngles() heading about Y

fields.name: scale
fields.unit: uniform GetScale(); 1.0 when the source row is 5-wide

fields.name: prefab_id
fields.unit: index into the prefab catalogue; the prefabIdx SoA column

fields.name: class_code
fields.unit: render-class code, 255 = NO_CLASS; derived from the prefab catalogue, not carried by the JSON row

fields.name: _pad
fields.unit: always 0 — present so the struct is exactly 32 B with no compiler padding a Pod cast would expose as uninitialised

oneOf.description: Legacy positional tuple `[id, prefabId, x, y, z?, rotationDeg?]`, the input form the binary compiler accepts. Position 0 is the string id, position 1 the integer prefabId, and positions 2..5 are numbers (x, y, z?, rotationDeg?).

Chunk wire tuple `[prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg]` or, at objects schemaVersion 1.1.0 and above, `[prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, scale]` — all numbers, exactly 5 or 8 wide, never 6 or 7. The trailing three are written only when non-trivial (pitchDeg != 0, rollDeg != 0, or scale != 1 after rounding: angles to 2 dp, scale to 3 dp); a reader that does not find them assumes 0, 0, 1. Angle order follows Enfusion `GetAngles()`: pitch about X, heading about Y (`rotationDeg`), roll about Z; `scale` is the entity's uniform `GetScale()`. The instance id is derived from the chunk file and row index ({cx}_{cy}:{index}), which makes it unique by construction. Written only by `objects/chunks/{cx}_{cy}.json.gz`.
